rule: Load the index's rows by INSERT ... SELECT from a virtual table over the arena (rusqlite's vtab) and compare with the prepared-statement writer on T2; keep whichever wins by more than 10%. Without such a winner the prepared-statement writer stands and the gate checklist records undecided, default kept. The rule is read against the whole index write, the writer the load is compared with.
method: Out of the tree, against duscope-core at this commit: one warm scan of T2 into an arena and its roll-up, and the dirs and files tables' rows (all 24 and 17 columns) built from it once. Per run, on a fresh file with the writer's connection setup (journal_mode OFF, synchronous OFF, exclusive locking, temp_store MEMORY, a 64 MiB cache) and its tables: (a) the load by one prepared INSERT per table, executed per row, in one transaction, as IndexWriter::entry_rows does; (b) the load by INSERT INTO dirs SELECT * FROM arena_dirs; INSERT INTO files SELECT * FROM arena_files, from two eponymous virtual tables whose cursors read the same rows; (c) IndexWriter::write whole. The rows are built before the clock starts, so (a) and (b) differ in the insertion alone. The bundled SQLite at -O1 with the repository's LIBSQLITE3_FLAGS, a release build with LTO. Median of 9 runs per measurement, the measurement repeated three times; the figures below are the median repeat's.
decision: undecided, default kept: the prepared-statement writer stands
why: The virtual tables load the rows 12.7% faster (0.328 against 0.376 us per entry), but the load is a third of the write: its 48 ms are 4.3% of the 1.10 s the writer takes, short of the 10% the rule asks of a winner on the writer. A virtual table also needs unsafe impls of rusqlite's VTab and VTabCursor (repr(C) structs over SQLite's own), which duscope-core's forbid(unsafe_code) rules out. Linux was not measured: alpha has no T2 tree, and a write that costs more per entry there (1.74 to 1.93 us on the bench runner) leaves the load a share no larger than a third.
code: The experiment is not kept (it needs unsafe); crates/duscope-core/src/index/vtab.rs was never added. The method above reruns it.
